subServiceContent.tagline: The Smart Dual Solution for Water & Heat Insulation In light of harsh climatic conditions and soaring temperatures, waterproofing alone is no longer enough to protect buildings. At Taj Al Rahmah, we offer the integrated 'Combo System'—a revolutionary technology that combines waterproofing, thermal insulation, and final finishing in a single process. This makes it the premier choice for modern projects, commercial buildings, and residential villas.

content.serviceContent:
What is the Combo System?

It is an advanced insulation system consisting of multiple bonded layers, starting with Polyurethane Foam, which acts as a high-quality thermal and water barrier. The system is finalized with cementitious and acrylic protective layers. The hallmark of this system is that it creates a single, solid, seamless joint-free layer, providing absolute protection against both heat and water leakage.

1. Dual Insulation (Thermal & Water)

The system acts as a shield against rainwater while simultaneously blocking solar heat from penetrating the building, ensuring a cool and comfortable indoor environment.

2. Massive Energy Savings

Thanks to its superior thermal efficiency, the Combo System helps reduce electricity bills by up to 40% by significantly decreasing the load on air conditioning units.

3. Lightweight & Durable

Unlike traditional heavy insulation systems, the Combo System is lightweight, reducing the dead load on the building's structure while remaining durable enough to withstand foot traffic and movement on the roof.

4. Long-term Warranty

Due to the system's robustness and reliability, Taj Al Rahmah provides a warranty of up to 25 years against leakage, giving you total peace of mind for decades.

Our Implementation Stages

  • Surface Cleaning: Removing all dust and impurities to ensure maximum adhesion of materials to the concrete.
  • Polyurethane (PU Foam) Spraying: Applying a dense layer of foam that expands to seal all holes and corners, providing instant thermal and water insulation.
  • UV Coating: Applying a protective layer to shield the foam from ultraviolet rays and extreme weather fluctuations.
  • Flood Test: Submerging the roof in water for 48 hours to ensure a 100% leak-free application.
  • Final Screed: Casting a protective cementitious screed with precise slopes to ensure proper water drainage toward the outlets.
